verses.ar: يُبْعَثُ مِنْ تِهَامَةَ، بَيْنَ يَدَيِ الْقِيَامَةْ، فِيْ ظَهْرِهِ عَلامَةٌ، تُظِلُّهُ الْغَمَامَةُ تُطِيعُهُ السَّحَائِبْ
verses.tr: Yubʿathu min tihāmah, bayna yadayil-qiyāmah, fī ẓahrihi ʿalāmah, tuẓilluhul-ghamāmatu tuṭīʿuhus-saḥāʾib
verses.en: He will be sent forth from Tihama, just before the Day of Resurrection; on his back is a mark; the cloud shades him and the rain-clouds obey him.
His brow is like the dawn, and his flowing locks are like the night.

verses.ar: أَلِفِيُّ الْأَنْفِ مِيْمِيُّ الْفَمِ نُونِيُّ الْحَاجِبْ
verses.en: His nose is shaped like the letter Alif, his mouth like the Mim, and his eyebrows like the Nun.

verses.ar: سَمْعُهُ يَسْمَعُ صَرِيْرَ الْقَلَمِ، بَصَرُهُ إِلَى السَّبْعِ الطِّبَاقِ ثَاقِبْ
verses.tr: Samʿuhu yasmaʿu ṣarīral-qalam, baṣaruhu ilas-sabʿiṭ-ṭibāqi thāqib
verses.en: His hearing perceives the scratching of the Pen; his sight pierces through the seven heavens.

verses.ar: قَدَمَاهُ قَبَّلَهُمَا الْبَعِيرُ فَأَزَالَا مَا اشْتَكَاهُ مِنَ الْمِحَنِ وَالنَّوَائِبْ
verses.tr: Qadamāhu qabbalahumal-baʿīru fa-azālā mash-takāhu minal-miḥani wan-nawāʾib
verses.en: His two feet — the camel kissed them, and they removed the trials and hardships of which it had complained.

verses.ar: آمَنَ بِهِ الضَّبُّ وَسَلَّمَت عَلَيهِ الْأَشْجَارُ وَخَاطَبَتْهُ الْأَحْجَارُ وَحَنَّ إِلَيْهِ الْجِذْعُ حَنِينَ حَزِيْنٍ نَادِبْ
verses.tr: Āmana bihiḍ-ḍabbu wa sallamat ʿalayhil-ashjāru wa khāṭabat-hul-aḥjāru wa ḥanna ilayhil-jidhʿu ḥanīna ḥazīnin nādib
verses.en: The lizard believed in him, the trees greeted him with peace, the stones spoke to him, and the palm-trunk yearned for him with the yearning of one grieving and lamenting.

verses.ar: يَدَاهُ تَظْهَرُ بَرَكَتُهُمَا فِيْ الْمَطَاعِمِ وَالْمَشَارِبْ
verses.en: His two hands — their blessing shows itself in food and in drink.

verses.ar: قَلْبُهُ لا يَغْفُلُ وَلا يَنَامُ وَلَكِن لِلْخِدْمَةِ عَلٰى الدَّوَامِ مُرَاقِبْ
verses.tr: Qalbuhu lā yaghfulu wa lā yanāmu wa lākin lil-khidmati ʿalad-dawāmi murāqib
verses.en: His heart is never heedless and never sleeps; rather it is ever watchful, in constant devoted service.

verses.tr: In ūdhiya yaʿfū wa lā yuʿāqib
verses.en: When he is harmed, he pardons and does not punish.

verses.tr: Wa in khūṣima yaṣmutu wa lā yujāwib
verses.en: When he is quarrelled with, he keeps silent and does not retort.
[Allah says:] I raise him to the noblest of ranks,

verses.ar: فِيْ رَكْبَةٍ لا تَنْبَغِيْ قَبْلَهُ وَلا بَعْدَهُ لِرَاكِبْ
verses.tr: Fī rakbatin lā tanbaghī qablahu wa lā baʿdahu li-rākib
verses.en: upon a mount befitting no rider before him or after him,

verses.ar: فِيْ مَوْكِبٍ مِنَ الْمَلائِكَةِ يَفُوْقُ عَلٰى سَائِرِ الْمَواكِبْ
verses.tr: Fī mawkibin minal-malāʾikati yafūqu ʿalā sāʾiril-mawākib
verses.en: in a procession of angels surpassing every other procession.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا ارْتَقَىْ عَلٰى الْكَوْنَيْنِ وَانْفَصَلَ عَنِ الْعَالَمَيْنِ كُنتُ لَهُ أَنَا النَّدَيْمَ وَالْمُخَاطِبْ
verses.tr: Fa-idhar-taqā ʿalal-kawnayni wan-faṣala ʿanil-ʿālamayni kuntu lahu anan-nadīma wal-mukhāṭib
verses.en: And when he rises above the two worlds and parts from the two realms, I Myself am his companion and the One who speaks with him.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَرُدُّهُ مِنَ الْعَرْشِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَبْرُدَ الْفَرْشُ وَقَدْ نَالَ جَمِيعَ الْمَآرِبْ
verses.tr: Thumma arudduhu minal-ʿarshi qabla an yabrudal-farshu wa qad nāla jamīʿal-māʾrib
verses.en: Then I return him from the Throne before his bed grows cold, having attained all his desires.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا شُرِّفَتْ تُرْبَةُ طَيْبَةَ مِنْهُ بِأَشْرَفِ قَالِبْ
verses.tr: Fa-idhā shurrifat turbatu Ṭaybata minhu bi-ashrafi qālib
verses.en: And when the soil of Tayba is ennobled by his most noble form,

verses.ar: سَعَتْ إِلَيْهِ أَرْوَاحُ الْمُحِبِّيْنَ عَلٰى الْأَقْدَامِ وَالنَّجَائِبْ
verses.en: the souls of the lovers hasten to him, some on foot and some upon swift camels.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih
verses.en: O Allah, bless him, grant him peace, and pour Your blessings upon him and his family.
